applications.מספר בקשה: key: one application per number (status history collapsed to the latest stage), kpi:applications

applications.תאריך הגשה: chart-filings, chart-lag, chart-lag-trend, chart-fate, chart-heat, insight:filings, insight:fate

applications.שם האמצאה באנגלית: skip: free-text invention title (English); no controlled vocabulary to aggregate on
applications.מספר בקשה בינלאומי: chart-filings, chart-origin, insight:origin, insight:filings — PCT route and receiving office from its prefix

applications.תאריך פרסום שני: skip: 5,073 rows carry a 1900-01-01 placeholder and 17% are empty; not reliable as a timeline
